recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Future work about additional DiagnosticReport actor roles, target types, or responsible-party distinctions should be handled under newer targeted Jira issues rather than by reintroducing the original performer.role binding proposal.
issue_request: FHIR-13169 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request raised against DSTU2. It initially asked whether DiagnosticReport.performer.role should bind extensibly to v3 ParticipationType, but the final accepted resolution instead chose to revert DiagnosticReport.performer to an R2-style 0..* performer reference, add aliases, add DiagnosticReport.resultsInterpreter 0..*, and leave other actor roles for extensions if needed.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in git commit 2bc0950a1e354c2a99db1fca80954166c25bc241, whose message included #13169. That commit removed DiagnosticReport.performer.role and DiagnosticReport.performer.actor from the then-authoritative spreadsheet source, made DiagnosticReport.performer a direct 0..* Reference(Practitioner|Organization) with responsible-service semantics, added DiagnosticReport.resultsInterpreter 0..*, and added a results-interpreter search parameter.
additional_context: DiagnosticReport is active in source/fhir.ini, and current source is in source/diagnosticreport/structuredefinition-DiagnosticReport.xml. Later applied issues refined the same elements without reversing the split: FHIR-22147 added Device to performer, FHIR-49190 added Patient and RelatedPerson support and guidance, and FHIR-50943 updated the resultsInterpreter short description. Exact FHIR-13169 Zulip and Confluence searches found no community record that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current build-scope source contains DiagnosticReport.performer and DiagnosticReport.resultsInterpreter as separate 0..* reference elements and contains no DiagnosticReport.performer.role or performer-role binding to update.
